stages: Write programs and understand the web
Programming, computer science, HTTP and ordinary accessible interfaces come first.
Build trustworthy backend and data systems
Model relational state, enforce identity and permission, and recover versioned data pipelines.
Learn mathematics, machine learning and neural models
Work through probability and gradients, train and evaluate baselines, then trace neural and language-model mechanisms.
Build model interactions, classification and clustering
Use model and prompting foundations to compare known-label prediction and open-ended grouping before retrieval applications.
Only now introduce RAG, document processing, retrieval, context and independently checked answers.
Deliver reliable interfaces and realtime experiences
Connect the earlier frontend foundations to product behavior, streamed output, bidirectional events and speech.
Choose controlled agents and interoperable tools
Learn bounded workflows and authority before framework choices and remote protocol integration.
Evaluate, observe and operate production systems
Diagnose live behavior, evaluate action traces, manage model artifacts and recover releases.
Integrate, demonstrate and defend the system
Connect the layers, reproduce failures and defend the resulting implementation.
